$comment: The syntax highlighting palette, in one place.
It lived only as raw hex in apps/rite-studio/src/highlight.css, which was
fine while a stylesheet was the only thing that drew Rite. `rite render`
draws it too, and a second copy of eleven colours is a drift waiting to
happen: change one, and generated images disagree with the site with nothing
to catch it. Same one-table reasoning as grammar/aliases.json.
`kinds` keys are the TokenKind values in highlight.css / rite-render, and the
CSS class for each is `.tok-<kind>`. Both sides are checked against this file
by crates/rite-cli/tests/palette_sync.rs, which also re-derives the contrast
figures below rather than trusting this comment.
